info.title: Hedgin manager bot API
info.description: Versioned HTTP API for approved manager bots. Reads vault state and builds unsigned Solana transactions. The bot signs locally with the vault's current authority key. Runs only on Solana mainnet-beta.

get.description:
Requires key scope `read`.

Returns the vaults whose on-chain authority is the key's manager, filtered to the key's vault allowlist when it has one. The list can be up to 15 seconds old.

Requires key scope `read`.

Returns the vault's on-chain state with display metadata: status, fees, limits, pending totals, and NAV epoch. The data can be up to 15 seconds old. The authority check always reads the chain.

parameters.name: vault
parameters.description: Vault public key. Must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one, and the key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority.

200.description: The vault address and its data.

get.description:
Requires key scope `read`.

Returns a live valuation of idle tokens and every open strategy. The data can be up to 15 seconds old. When `partial` is `true`, at least one price was unavailable. A missing valuation is not zero.

parameters.name: vault
parameters.description: Vault public key. Must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one, and the key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority.

200.description: The vault address and its data.

get.description:
Requires key scope `read`.

Returns the vault's open strategies sorted by id. A strategy whose protocol account cannot be read appears with `type: "unreadable"`. The data can be up to 15 seconds old.

parameters.name: vault
parameters.description: Vault public key. Must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one, and the key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority.

200.description: The vault address and its data.

get.description:
Requires key scope `read`.

Returns posted NAV points.

parameters.name: vault
parameters.description: Vault public key. Must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one, and the key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of points. Must be a positive integer. Default 200. Values above 2000 return 2000 points.

200.description: The vault address and its data.

get.description:
Requires key scope `read`.

Returns open deposit and withdrawal requests. The data can be up to 10 seconds old.

parameters.name: vault
parameters.description: Vault public key. Must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one, and the key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority.

200.description: The vault address and its data.

get.description:
Requires key scope `read`.

Returns closed strategies with their recorded token flows.

parameters.name: vault
parameters.description: Vault public key. Must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one, and the key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority.

200.description: The vault address and its data.

get.description:
Requires key scope `read`.

Returns the vault's Phoenix trader status, markets, open orders, withdrawable collateral, and margin account. `openOrders` carries the `priceInTicks` and `orderSequenceNumber` that a by-id `phoenix/cancel` needs. Fields that come from Phoenix are `null` when Phoenix data is unavailable. The data can be up to 10 seconds old.

parameters.name: vault
parameters.description: Vault public key. Must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one, and the key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority.

200.description: The vault address and its data.

get.description:
Requires key scope `read`.

Returns a Jupiter quote for a swap from the vault. A quote does not reserve a price. The later build fetches its own route.

parameters.name: vault
parameters.description: A vault this key may access. The server checks the allowlist and current on-chain authority before it reads.

parameters.name: slippageBps
parameters.description: Integer from 1 to 10000. The quote uses the lower of this value and the protocol's `maxSlippageBps`.

200.description: The vault address and the quote.

get.description:
Requires key scope `read`.

Searches Meteora DLMM pools by name, symbol, or address. Returns 20 pools per page.

parameters.name: vault
parameters.description: A vault this key may access. The server checks the allowlist and current on-chain authority before it reads.

200.description: The vault address and one page of pools.

get.description:
Requires key scope `read`.

Returns one pool with its active bin, which you need to choose a `dlmm/open` range. The data can be up to 3 seconds old. `maxActiveBinSlippage` on the build covers later drift.

parameters.name: vault
parameters.description: A vault this key may access. The server checks the allowlist and current on-chain authority before it reads.

200.description: The vault address and the pool.

get.description:
Requires key scope `read`.

Returns symbol, decimals, logo, USD price, and Jupiter verification for any mint. Use it to show a pasted address before you quote it. `verified` is `null` when Jupiter's token search is unavailable. An unknown mint returns 404.

parameters.name: vault
parameters.description: A vault this key may access. The server checks the allowlist and current on-chain authority before it reads.

200.description: The vault address and the token.

post.description:
Requires key scope `jupiter/initialize`.

Returns an unsigned v0 transaction for the manager to sign. Do not send `payer`: the API sets it to the key's manager and rejects a body that contains it. Unknown fields are ignored. The key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority, and the vault must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one.

Records the Jupiter strategy that a swap into `targetMint` needs. `jupiter/swap` creates it automatically, so call this only to prepare ahead of time.

Requires key scope `jupiter/swap`.

Returns an unsigned v0 transaction for the manager to sign. Do not send `payer`: the API sets it to the key's manager and rejects a body that contains it. Unknown fields are ignored. The key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority, and the vault must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one.

Swaps vault tokens through Jupiter. When this is the first swap into a token, the step also creates its Jupiter strategy (`initializesStrategy: true`). If the setup does not fit, the step creates the strategy only and `next` repeats `jupiter/swap`. When the swap sells the vault's whole balance of a non-deposit token, the step also closes that token's strategy, or `next` points to `jupiter/sweep` when the close does not fit.

initializesStrategy.description: `true` when this step creates the Jupiter strategy.

post.summary: Sell all of a token and close its strategy
post.description:
Requires key scope `jupiter/sweep`.

Returns an unsigned v0 transaction for the manager to sign. Do not send `payer`: the API sets it to the key's manager and rejects a body that contains it. Unknown fields are ignored. The key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority, and the vault must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one.

In one transaction, sells the vault's entire balance of `mint` to the deposit mint and closes the token's Jupiter strategy. With a zero balance, the step only closes the strategy. Returns 409 `MintInUse` while an open DLMM position or limit order uses the mint, and 409 `NothingToSweep` when no Jupiter strategy exists for it. Returns 422 `SweepUnroutable` when Jupiter finds no route.

mint.description: Token to sell. Must differ from the vault's deposit mint.

post.description:
Requires key scope `dlmm/initialize`.

Returns an unsigned v0 transaction for the manager to sign. Do not send `payer`: the API sets it to the key's manager and rejects a body that contains it. Unknown fields are ignored. The key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority, and the vault must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one.

Creates an empty position of at most 70 bins, plus any missing Jupiter strategies for the pair's non-deposit tokens. Send either `width` (centered on the active bin) or both `lowerBinId` and `upperBinId`. `upperBinId` is exclusive here. The response's `upperBinId` is the inclusive last bin the position holds.

width.description: Number of bins around the active bin. Used when either bin id is missing.

upperBinId.description: Exclusive end bin. Must be greater than `lowerBinId` and at most 70 bins above it.

post.description:
Requires key scope `dlmm/open`.

Returns an unsigned v0 transaction for the manager to sign. Do not send `payer`: the API sets it to the key's manager and rejects a body that contains it. Unknown fields are ignored. The key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority, and the vault must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one.

Creates a position and adds liquidity. `upperBinId` is exclusive and the range spans at most 1400 bins. At least one of `amountX` and `amountY` must be greater than zero. A range of up to 70 bins returns one step, or two when the setup does not fit with the deposit. A wider range returns a batch: position creation, resize steps, and funding steps. The first step always carries `position`, `lowerBinId`, and the inclusive `upperBinId`.

upperBinId.description: Exclusive end bin. Must be greater than `lowerBinId`.

200.description: Build result. One step or a batch. The first step adds `position`, `lowerBinId`, and `upperBinId`.

post.description:
Requires key scope `dlmm/add`.

Returns an unsigned v0 transaction for the manager to sign. Do not send `payer`: the API sets it to the key's manager and rejects a body that contains it. Unknown fields are ignored. The key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority, and the vault must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one.

Adds liquidity to an existing position, optionally to an inclusive sub-range. A position wider than 70 bins returns a batch of funding steps.

position.description: DLMM position owned by the vault.

lowerBinId.description: Inclusive first bin of a sub-range. Send it together with `upperBinId` or omit both.

upperBinId.description: Inclusive last bin of a sub-range. Must lie inside the position.

200.description: Build result. One step, or a batch for a wide position.

post.description:
Requires key scope `dlmm/add-range`.

Returns an unsigned v0 transaction for the manager to sign. Do not send `payer`: the API sets it to the key's manager and rejects a body that contains it. Unknown fields are ignored. The key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority, and the vault must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one.

Continuation action. Builds the funding batch for a wide position from `cursorBinId` to the end of the position or selection. Send the `next.body` from a confirmed `dlmm/extend` step. Returns 400 when the position range changed since the flow started.

position.description: DLMM position owned by the vault.

targetUpperBinId.description: Inclusive last bin the position must reach.

amountX.description: Token X to add, base units.

amountY.description: Token Y to add, base units.

activeBinId.description: Active bin observed when the flow started. The build fails with 409 `Stale` when the live active bin is further away than `maxActiveBinSlippage`.

lowerBinId.description: Inclusive first bin of a sub-range. Send it together with `upperBinId` or omit both.

upperBinId.description: Inclusive last bin of a sub-range. Must lie inside the position.

cursorBinId.description: First bin still to fund. Must lie inside the position or selection.

post.description:
Requires key scope `dlmm/extend`.

Returns an unsigned v0 transaction for the manager to sign. Do not send `payer`: the API sets it to the key's manager and rejects a body that contains it. Unknown fields are ignored. The key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority, and the vault must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one.

Continuation action. Adds up to 91 bins to the top of a position toward `targetUpperBinId`, up to 1400 bins in total. `next` repeats `dlmm/extend` until the target is reached, then points to `dlmm/add-range`.

position.description: DLMM position owned by the vault.

targetUpperBinId.description: Inclusive last bin the position must reach.

amountX.description: Token X to add, base units.

amountY.description: Token Y to add, base units.

activeBinId.description: Active bin observed when the flow started. The build fails with 409 `Stale` when the live active bin is further away than `maxActiveBinSlippage`.

lowerBinId.description: Inclusive first bin of a sub-range. Send it together with `upperBinId` or omit both.

upperBinId.description: Inclusive last bin of a sub-range. Must lie inside the position.

post.description:
Requires key scope `dlmm/remove`.

Returns an unsigned v0 transaction for the manager to sign. Do not send `payer`: the API sets it to the key's manager and rejects a body that contains it. Unknown fields are ignored. The key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority, and the vault must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one.

Removes `bpsToRemove` of the liquidity in the position or in an inclusive sub-range. A position of up to 70 bins without `cursorBinId` returns one step. Otherwise the build returns a batch of `sendConcurrently` steps from `cursorBinId` upward. When the pair's Jupiter strategies are missing, a setup barrier step comes first.

position.description: DLMM position owned by the vault.

cursorBinId.description: First bin to process. Use it to resume after partial progress.

lowerBinId.description: Inclusive first bin of a sub-range. Send it together with `upperBinId` or omit both.

upperBinId.description: Inclusive last bin of a sub-range. Must lie inside the position.

200.description: Build result. One step or a batch.

post.summary: Flip bins to the other side
post.description:
Requires key scope `dlmm/flip`.

Returns an unsigned v0 transaction for the manager to sign. Do not send `payer`: the API sets it to the key's manager and rejects a body that contains it. Unknown fields are ignored. The key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority, and the vault must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one.

In one transaction, withdraws all liquidity from the selected bins and re-adds that token there with the `bidAsk` shape. The bins must lie entirely above or entirely below the active bin. Fees are not claimed. Returns 409 `Stale` when the active bin moved more than `maxActiveBinSlippage` from `activeBinId`, and 400 when the selection does not fit in one transaction.

position.description: DLMM position owned by the vault.

lowerBinId.description: Inclusive first bin, inside the position.

upperBinId.description: Inclusive last bin, inside the position.

post.description:
Requires key scope `dlmm/claim-fee`.

Returns an unsigned v0 transaction for the manager to sign. Do not send `payer`: the API sets it to the key's manager and rejects a body that contains it. Unknown fields are ignored. The key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority, and the vault must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one.

Claims swap fees from a position into the vault. A position of up to 70 bins without `cursorBinId` returns one step. Otherwise the build returns a batch of `sendConcurrently` steps.

position.description: DLMM position owned by the vault.

200.description: Build result. One step or a batch.

post.description:
Requires key scope `dlmm/zap-out`.

Returns an unsigned v0 transaction for the manager to sign. Do not send `payer`: the API sets it to the key's manager and rejects a body that contains it. Unknown fields are ignored. The key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority, and the vault must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one.

Removes all liquidity, claims fees, swaps the non-deposit token to the deposit mint, and closes the position's strategy. The vault's deposit mint must be one side of the pair. A wide position, a `cursorBinId`, or a long route returns a batch. The last step can carry `next` to `jupiter/sweep`, which sells the remaining non-deposit token and closes its strategy.

position.description: DLMM position owned by the vault.

cursorBinId.description: First bin to process. Use it to resume after partial progress.

200.description: Build result. One step or a batch.

post.description:
Requires key scope `dlmm/zap-out/swap`.

Returns an unsigned v0 transaction for the manager to sign. Do not send `payer`: the API sets it to the key's manager and rejects a body that contains it. Unknown fields are ignored. The key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority, and the vault must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one.

Continuation action. Swaps the tokens a zap returned to the deposit mint, one source per step, and closes a Jupiter strategy the zap created. Send the `next.body` from a confirmed step. Returns 409 `ZapBalanceChanged` when the vault balance fell below `balanceBefore`, and 409 `ZapNothingToSwap` when the position returned nothing to swap.

mint.description: Token to swap. Must differ from the deposit mint.

balanceBefore.description: Vault balance before the zap. Only the amount above it is swapped.

post.description:
Requires key scope `dlmm/close`.

Returns an unsigned v0 transaction for the manager to sign. Do not send `payer`: the API sets it to the key's manager and rejects a body that contains it. Unknown fields are ignored. The key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority, and the vault must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one.

Removes all liquidity, claims fees, and closes the position and its strategy. A position of up to 70 bins returns one step. A wider position returns a batch of `sendConcurrently` exit steps followed by a close barrier step.

position.description: DLMM position owned by the vault.

200.description: Build result. One step or a batch.

post.description:
Requires key scope `dlmm/limit-order/place`.

Returns an unsigned v0 transaction for the manager to sign. Do not send `payer`: the API sets it to the key's manager and rejects a body that contains it. Unknown fields are ignored. The key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority, and the vault must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one.

Places a limit order. An `ask` sells token X in bins above the active bin. A `bid` sells token Y in bins below it. The pool must accept limit orders. When missing bin arrays do not fit with the order, a setup step comes first. The step that places the order carries `limitOrder` and `strategy`.

amount.description: Amount of the sold token, base units. Must be greater than zero.

200.description: Build result. One step, or a setup step followed by the order step.

post.description:
Requires key scope `dlmm/limit-order/cancel`.

Returns an unsigned v0 transaction for the manager to sign. Do not send `payer`: the API sets it to the key's manager and rejects a body that contains it. Unknown fields are ignored. The key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority, and the vault must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one.

Cancels the listed bins, or every bin that still holds anything. Unfilled amounts, fill proceeds, and maker fees return to the vault. When no bin remains, the same transaction closes the strategy. Returns 400 when a listed bin holds nothing.

bins.description: Bin ids to cancel. Omit to cancel every non-empty bin.

post.description:
Requires key scope `phoenix/initialize`.

Returns an unsigned v0 transaction for the manager to sign. Do not send `payer`: the API sets it to the key's manager and rejects a body that contains it. Unknown fields are ignored. The key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority, and the vault must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one.

Records the vault's Phoenix trader strategy. The vault's deposit mint must be USDC.

Requires key scope `phoenix/onboard`.

Returns an unsigned v0 transaction for the manager to sign. Do not send `payer`: the API sets it to the key's manager and rejects a body that contains it. Unknown fields are ignored. The key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority, and the vault must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one.

Returns Phoenix's onboarding transaction for the vault's trader. The manager signs only as fee payer, and Phoenix co-signs. Submit it with `POST /transactions/phoenix/onboard/submit`. `POST /transactions/send` rejects its ticket. The step is not simulated (`simulation.deferred: true`). Returns 409 `PhoenixAlreadyOnboarded` when the trader is already onboarded.

Requires key scope `phoenix/deposit`.

Returns an unsigned v0 transaction for the manager to sign. Do not send `payer`: the API sets it to the key's manager and rejects a body that contains it. Unknown fields are ignored. The key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority, and the vault must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one.

Moves USDC from the vault into its Phoenix trader account.

Requires key scope `phoenix/withdraw`.

Returns an unsigned v0 transaction for the manager to sign. Do not send `payer`: the API sets it to the key's manager and rejects a body that contains it. Unknown fields are ignored. The key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority, and the vault must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one.

Withdraws USDC from the Phoenix trader account. Phoenix pays out immediately or queues the withdrawal. A queued withdrawal delivers canonical tokens. `phoenix/sweep` unwraps them.

Requires key scope `phoenix/order`.

Returns an unsigned v0 transaction for the manager to sign. Do not send `payer`: the API sets it to the key's manager and rejects a body that contains it. Unknown fields are ignored. The key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority, and the vault must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one.

Places a perp order. The builder converts `size` to base lots (rounding down) and `price` to ticks (rounding down). A market order is capped at the mark price plus or minus `slippageBps` and must fill in full. Returns 400 for an unknown market or a size below one base lot, and 422 `PhoenixNoMark` when a market order has no mark price.

size.description: Whole asset units, such as `"0.5"`. Not base units.

post.description:
Requires key scope `phoenix/cancel`.

Returns an unsigned v0 transaction for the manager to sign. Do not send `payer`: the API sets it to the key's manager and rejects a body that contains it. Unknown fields are ignored. The key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority, and the vault must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one.

Cancels every resting order in one market, or up to 20 orders by id. Read the ids from `openOrders` in `GET /vaults/{vault}/phoenix`.

Requires key scope `phoenix/sweep`.

Returns an unsigned v0 transaction for the manager to sign. Do not send `payer`: the API sets it to the key's manager and rejects a body that contains it. Unknown fields are ignored. The key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority, and the vault must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one.

Unwraps the canonical tokens a queued Phoenix withdrawal delivered into USDC in the vault.

Requires key scope `vault/initialize`.

Returns an unsigned v0 transaction for the manager to sign. Do not send `payer`: the API sets it to the key's manager and rejects a body that contains it. Unknown fields are ignored.

Creates a vault managed by the key's manager. The body has no `vault`. The key must have no vault allowlist (403 otherwise), and the manager must be whitelisted on chain (403 otherwise). The step's `vault` field and the response's top-level `vault` name the new vault. That address comes from the protocol's next vault id, so a vault that someone else creates first makes this transaction fail. Build again in that case.

Requires key scope `vault/update`.

Returns an unsigned v0 transaction for the manager to sign. Do not send `payer`: the API sets it to the key's manager and rejects a body that contains it. Unknown fields are ignored. The key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority, and the vault must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one.

Changes vault settings. Send at least one optional field. A body with none returns 400. A fee decrease applies at once. A fee increase is stored as pending (`pendingPerformanceFeeBps`, `pendingManagementFeeBps`) and applies at `feeEffectiveTs`. Changing only `status` or a pause flag does not restart a pending fee delay.

Requires key scope `vault/claim-fee`.

Returns an unsigned v0 transaction for the manager to sign. Do not send `payer`: the API sets it to the key's manager and rejects a body that contains it. Unknown fields are ignored. The key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority, and the vault must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one.

Mints the manager's accrued fee shares.

Requires key scope `vault/close`.

Returns an unsigned v0 transaction for the manager to sign. Do not send `payer`: the API sets it to the key's manager and rejects a body that contains it. Unknown fields are ignored. The key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority, and the vault must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one.

Closes the vault. The program rejects it unless the vault is eligible to close.

Requires key scope `strategy/close`.

Returns an unsigned v0 transaction for the manager to sign. Do not send `payer`: the API sets it to the key's manager and rejects a body that contains it. Unknown fields are ignored. The key's manager must be the vault's current on-chain authority, and the vault must be in the key's allowlist when the key has one.

Closes one strategy account. Returns 404 when the strategy does not exist and 400 when it belongs to another vault.

Requires key scope `send` and the builder action that produced the ticket.

Before the RPC call, the relay checks the ticket signature and expiry, the key, cluster, and program, current vault authority, that the message is unchanged, the fee payer, and the manager's Ed25519 signature. A failed check returns 403 with code `InvalidTicket`, `Forbidden`, `InvalidTransaction`, or `InvalidSignature`. A `phoenix/onboard` ticket returns 403: submit it with `POST /transactions/phoenix/onboard/submit`.

`status: "pending"` means the RPC accepted the transaction. `status: "unknown"` means the RPC call failed in a way that leaves the outcome ambiguous. In both cases, keep `signature` and `receipt` and poll `GET /transactions/status`. A preflight rejection returns 422 and nothing was sent.

Requires key scopes `send` and `phoenix/onboard`.

Runs the same checks as `POST /transactions/send` on a signed `phoenix/onboard` build. The transaction must invoke only the Phoenix program. The API then hands it to Phoenix, which co-signs and sends it. `status` is `unknown` when the Phoenix request failed in flight, timed out after 15 seconds, returned an unreadable reply, or named a different signature. Poll the receipt in that case. When Phoenix returns an error reply, the API returns 502 and no receipt.

200.description: Phoenix accepted the transaction or the outcome is unknown.

get.description:
Requires key scope `send`.

Reports the outcome of a sent transaction. Only `confirmed` means success. A receipt works only for the key that received it, and only for 24 hours. An expired or foreign receipt returns 403.

parameters.name: receipt
parameters.description: The `receipt` from a send response. URL-encode it.

bearerAuth.description: API key issued by a Hedgin administrator, in the form `hv1_<id>_<secret>`. `<id>` is 1 to 48 characters and `<secret>` is 32 to 128 characters, both from `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`.

Error.description: Every error response uses this envelope. Responses with status 500, 502, or 503 always carry the message `Service temporarily unavailable`. Responses with status 422 always carry the message `Transaction rejected during simulation or preflight`. In both cases `code` still names the cause.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code, such as `Validation`, `Forbidden`, or a decoded program error name.

message.description: Human-readable detail. Never contains provider logs.
message.example: vault must be a public key

PublicKey.description: Base58 Solana public key. The server decodes it and rejects anything that is not 32 bytes.

BaseUnitAmount.description: Non-negative integer in token base units, as a decimal string. Must fit in u64 (at most 18446744073709551615). Never a JSON number.

DecimalString.description: Non-negative decimal in whole units: up to 15 integer digits and up to 12 fractional digits.

U64String.description: Unsigned 64-bit integer as a decimal string of at most 20 digits.

MaxActiveBinSlippage.description: How many bins the pool's active bin may move before the transaction fails.

SlippageBps.description: Slippage tolerance in basis points. The server lowers it to the protocol's `maxSlippageBps` when it is higher.

unitsConsumed.description: Compute units the build-time simulation used. `0` when simulation was deferred.

deferred.description: `true` when the step depends on an earlier step in the same batch. RPC preflight checks it at send time instead.

NextStep.description: A follow-up build. After this step confirms, call `POST /transactions/{path}` with `body` unchanged. `body` never contains `payer`.

path.description: Builder action name, such as `jupiter/sweep` or `dlmm/add-range`.

body.description: Request body for the follow-up build.

BuiltStep.description: One unsigned transaction and its ticket. Builders can add action metadata fields next to these.

transaction.description: Unsigned Solana v0 transaction, base64. At most 1232 bytes decoded. The fee payer is the key's manager. Builder-added signatures, such as a new position keypair, are already present.

ticket.description: Signed build ticket. Expires 90 seconds after the build. Binds the exact message, key, manager, vault, action, cluster, and program.

blockhash.description: Recent blockhash in the transaction message.

sendConcurrently.description: Consecutive steps with `sendConcurrently: true` may be submitted together. A step without it is a confirmation barrier.

transaction.description: The built transaction after the manager signed it, base64. The message must be byte-for-byte the one the build returned.

ticket.description: The `ticket` from the same build step.

signature.description: Base58 transaction signature (the manager's fee-payer signature).

receipt.description: Status receipt for `GET /transactions/status`. Valid for 24 hours and only for the key that sent it.

status.description: `pending`: the relay accepted the transaction. `unknown`: the outcome is ambiguous and the transaction may have landed. Neither value means confirmed.
`pending`: not yet confirmed and the blockhash is still valid. `confirmed`: landed at confirmed commitment or better without error. `expired`: the blockhash expired and the transaction never landed.

priceUsd.description: USD per whole token (base units / 10^decimals). Display only.

uiMultiplier.description: Token-2022 scaled UI amount multiplier. Absent for unscaled mints. Display only.

name.description: Display name: the listing name when set, otherwise `chainName`.

chainName.description: Name stored on chain, or `Vault #<id>` when empty.

totalAssets.description: Last posted total assets, deposit-token base units.

navPerShare.description: Last posted value of one share base unit in deposit base units, scaled by 10^9.

lastNavTs.description: Unix seconds of the last NAV post.

navEpoch.description: Epoch of the last posted NAV, decimal string.

strategy.description: Always null. Vault strategy text was replaced by `tags`.

xHandle.description: Set only when a Hedgin administrator verified it.

unmanagedHoldings.description: Non-deposit tokens in the vault outside any strategy.

highWaterMark.description: All-time highest NAV per share after fees, same scale as `navPerShare`.

value.description: Live estimate in deposit base units. `null` when unpriced, which is not zero.

navTotalAssets.description: On-chain NAV total assets, for comparison.

solPriceUsd.description: USD per whole SOL today, for showing values in SOL. `null` when no price is available.

partial.description: `true` when at least one price was unavailable. A missing valuation is not zero.

unpriced.description: Symbols of tokens with no price.

StrategyView.description: One open strategy. `type` selects the shape. All shapes share `address`, `id`, `createdTs`, and `lastActionTs`.

equity.description: Collateral + unrealized PnL + unsettled funding, floored at 0. USDC base units.

overridden.description: `true` when an administrator override set this NAV.

exact.description: `false` for strategies opened before exact accounting was recorded.

realizedPnl.description: returned + feesRetained - contributed, base units. Can be negative.

status.description: `none`: no Phoenix strategy. `registered`: strategy exists, trader not onboarded. `ready`: can deposit and trade.

usdcVault.description: Phoenix strategies need a USDC deposit mint.

markPrice.description: USD per base unit. `"0"` when the mark is unavailable.

withdrawable.description: USDC base units withdrawable while the account stays healthy. `null` when Phoenix data is unavailable.

slippageBps.description: Slippage the quote used, after the protocol cap.

priceUsd.description: USD per whole token, from Meteora; null when it has none.

marketCap.description: USD market cap, from Meteora; null when it has none.

priceUsd.description: USD per whole token, from Meteora; null when it has none.

marketCap.description: USD market cap, from Meteora; null when it has none.

dynamicFeePct.description: Percent: the volatility fee charged on top of baseFeePct right now. Null when Meteora does not report it.

BadRequest.description: Invalid path, query, or body. Builder messages name the field, such as `amount: must be a non-negative integer string`.

error.message: vault must be a public key

Unauthorized.description: Missing, malformed, unknown, revoked, or expired API key.

Forbidden.description: The key lacks the required scope, the vault is outside the key's allowlist, or the key's manager is not the vault's current on-chain authority.

error.message: Action is not enabled for this key

NotFound.description: Unknown route, or the vault, mint, pool, or strategy does not exist.

Conflict.description: Chain state conflicts with the request. Read current state before you build again.

error.message: pool price moved; refresh before flipping

Unprocessable.description: Simulation or RPC preflight rejected the transaction, or it does not fit in Solana transactions. `code` is the decoded program error name when one exists.

error.message: Transaction rejected during simulation or preflight

InternalError.description: Internal error, including a builder that returned an invalid transaction (`BuildFailed`).

BadGateway.description: An upstream provider (Jupiter, Meteora, or Phoenix) failed.

ServiceUnavailable.description: RPC, key store, or service configuration unavailable.
